convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iRSI indicator. Entry/exit rules are straightforward (divergence, overbought/oversold reversal, centerline confirmation). Fixed or risk-percent position sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic—only standard Trade.mqh helpers for order execution. No multi-timeframe, no hedging, no grid, no martingale.

derived_values.name: Recent low price index for bullish divergence
Previous low price index for bullish divergence
Recent high price index for bearish divergence
Previous high price index for bearish divergence

long.left: Bullish Divergence (price lower low + RSI higher low, with previous RSI below Oversold+5)

short.left: Bearish Divergence (price higher high + RSI lower high, with previous RSI above Overbought-5)

other_exits: RSI Level Exit: close BUY when RSI[0] >= Overbought level, close SELL when RSI[0] <= Oversold level (if InpUse_RSI_Level_Exit=true)
Session End Exit: close all positions when trading session ends (if CloseAtEndTime=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If InpUseRiskManagement=true, use risk_percent method (InpRiskPercent of equity divided by stop_loss_money_per_lot); otherwise use fixed_lots (InpLots=0.1)

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses RSI[1] and RSI[2] (previous two completed bars), never RSI[0] (forming bar). Divergence detection splits lookback into two halves and finds lowest/highest in each half. Bullish divergence requires previous low RSI below Oversold+5; bearish divergence requires previous high RSI above Overbought-5. Centerline confirmation is an AND gate on top of divergence/reversal signals. Daily profit/loss limits are calculated from closed deals + floating PnL of open positions. News filter is a simple time window around a single daily event. Time filter supports multiple sessions per day separated by semicolons.
python_conversion_notes: Divergence detection requires careful porting—iLowest/iHighest logic needs equivalent pandas/numpy rolling min/max with two separate lookback windows. The RSI crossover checks use shift(1) and shift(2) on the RSI series. Trailing stop runs on every tick; in Python backtesting this must be evaluated at each bar or tick. Position gate is no_position (flat only)—only one trade at a time. The daily limit PnL calculation iterates deal history which maps to vectorized trade log analysis. Time filter parsing of semicolon-delimited HH:MM-HH:MM strings needs a parser. No digit adjustment is needed—SL/TP are specified in points and multiplied by _Point directly.
